name: add_filter
description: Add a filter; it gets the next free id (f1, f2, …).

name: remove_filter
description: Remove a filter and its expectations.

name: reorder_filters
description: Move a filter to a position (0 is first).

name: add_input
description: Add a JSON input; it gets the next free id (i1, i2, …).

name: remove_input
description: Remove an input and its expectations.

name: reorder_inputs
description: Move an input to a position (0 is first).

name: set_expected
description: Pin what a filter should output for an input: the list of every output, in order ([x] for a single output x).

name: clear_expected
description: Remove the expectation of a filter for an input.

name: outputs
description: Every filter × input: the outputs or the error, the expected outputs and whether they pass.

name: input_shape
description: A compact type sketch of an input, like {a: number, items: [{id: string}]}.

name: get_input
description: The part of an input at a JSON pointer: "" for all of it, "/items/0" for the first item.
